fields.summary_ko.0: Nvidia (NVDA) recorded its worst single day in approximately 22 months; however, transition to Vera Rubin platform is proceeding faster than Blackwell, with approximately $20 billion in revenue in the first quarter.
fields.summary_ko.1: Nvidia's supply-related commitments surged to $390B in Q3 from $119B in the prior quarter two months earlier, and cloud industry backlog reached $2.5T, an increase of $500B over three months.
